title: Seen by Site Selectors
description: Your site and its full supporting documentation sit in the REDI Sites database, where Guild members and their teams evaluate locations.

title: Found by Everyone Else
description: The public viewer shows your site's basics and designation level to companies, developers, and brokers. Full documentation stays with Guild members.

title: Independent Validation
description: The standard was built by site selectors and is reviewed annually. Terracon reviews your documentation, then practicing site selectors confirm the score. This is not a self-reported checklist.

title: One National Standard
description: The same criteria in every state, so a Gold site in one market means what a Gold site means in another.

title: A Clear Roadmap
description: Every site gets a feedback report showing where it's strong and where gaps remain. That report is a practical plan for your next investment.

title: Marketing You Can Use
description: Designated sites receive marketing materials and the right to display the REDI Sites logo and their designation-level logo.

title: Ready When a Project Calls
description: Assemble your exhibits once, in a standard format, and answer fast when a prospect asks.
